text_to_image_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. One complete styled outfit, photorealistic product catalog image, portrait 2:3, pure white seamless background, soft studio light. Invisible hollow clothing with no person, body, skin or visible mannequin. Clothing: Oversized oatmeal boat-neck chunky rib-knit sweater with loose long sleeves, chocolate-brown washed wide-leg jeans, rounded brown suede shoes.  Accessories: One long dark bronze chain necklace with an oval deep red cabochon pendant. ; One medium-brown leather belt with a small antique brass oval buckle, loosely coiled. ; One dark chocolate brown leather saddle shoulder bag with rounded flap and adjustable strap.  All attachable accessories worn naturally on the ensemble at realistic scale. Unattachable tiny accessories arranged adjacent to the ensemble. Full uncropped framing, no text, logos or watermark.
original_prompt: Use case: compositing. Create one complete styled outfit catalog image for a wardrobe library. Image 1 is the existing clothing ensemble to preserve; subsequent images are the exact accessory products to incorporate. Preserve the clothing shapes, colors, fabrics, cut, shoes and natural drape of image 1. Add all listed accessories, scaled realistically: tie at collar or hip per notes, bag suspended from shoulder, belt threaded at waist, chains or charms attached to waist or bag, necklace draped naturally at neckline. This is one fully coordinated dressed ensemble, NOT a board of separately enlarged products. Keep tiny unattached items (earrings, rings, eyewear, hat, lipstick) in a small neatly spaced cluster beside the shoulder or hem only when they cannot be shown attached without inventing a body. Pure white opaque seamless background, soft studio light, minimal contact shadow, photoreal fabric and materials. Portrait 2:3, full ensemble uncropped with clear margin. ABSOLUTELY NO person, body, skin, face, head, neck, hands, legs, mannequin, hanger or stand. Empty hollow clothes; white visible through lace and empty space between separate garments. No labels, typography, logos, brand marks, watermark or frame. Never add extra garments or shoes not listed. Clothing: Oversized oatmeal boat-neck chunky rib-knit sweater with loose long sleeves, chocolate-brown washed wide-leg jeans, rounded brown suede shoes.  Accessories: One long dark bronze chain necklace with an oval deep red cabochon pendant. ; One medium-brown leather belt with a small antique brass oval buckle, loosely coiled. ; One dark chocolate brown leather saddle shoulder bag with rounded flap and adjustable strap.  Placement notes:  Only incorporate accessory types explicitly listed for this outfit; do not invent a belt, necklace or additional object. Clothing silhouette must remain identical to input 1.
